newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Adare sets 17.9 mln punt placing, open offer.
newsitem.headline: Adare sets 17.9 mln punt placing, open offer.

text.p: Ireland's Adare Printing Plc on Wednesday announced its intention to raise approximately 17.9 million Irish pounds net of expenses through the issue of 2.92 million new ordinary shares through a placing and open offer.

The open offer gives qualifying shareholders the opportunity to subscribe for their pro rata entitlement of the new ordinary shares on the basis of three new ordinary shares for every 11 ordinary shares held at close of business on June 25.

The company also said that it had reached provisional agreement to acquire the business and net assets of Kalamazoo Security Print (KSP) from Kalamzoo Computer Group Plc (KCG) for a consideration of 12.0 million pounds sterling.
The proceeds of the placing and open offer will be applied to the cost of acquiring KSP, to reduce group borrowings and to provide flexibility for investment and expansion.
The acquisition will include freehold and leasehold properties to which a value of 12.8 million sterling has been ascribed in the agreement which is used by KSP but owned by KCG.

KSP is based in Northfield, Birmingham, and employs some 355 people in the production of business forms, security products and security documents including watermarks and anti-counterfeiting features.
Adare said the acquisition falls into its strategy of acquiring established brands such as its purchase of Platignum and Prontaprint.

With a customer base of 40,000 KSP has historically had considerable market penetration and Adare envisages accessing the customer base to complement and support the wide range already supplied by Adare, it said.
